product_metadata.title: Culina Bamboo Cooking Utensils
features: Set of 6 utensils: Rounded fork, slotted spoon, mixing spoon, turner spatula, blending spatula, slotted spatula
Heat resistant, can be used on hot surfaces
description: Looking to equip your kitchen with cooking utensils that promote nature awareness, great craftsmanship and superior performance? Rejoice! Culina Wooden Cooking Utensils have it all in store for you! A set of 6 cooking essentials to strike the right balance between sustainability, convenience and efficiency. Bamboo's excellence from nature to your kitchen Culina Bamboo Wooden Cooking Utensils come as a set in a mesh bag. 1 mixing spoon, 1 rounded fork, 1 slotted spoon, 1 turner spatula, 1 slotted spatula and 1 blending spatula. Made of a renewable resource, they're the ultimate cookware for the environmentally conscious. The bamboo used in the crafting of our ware comes from a natural shoot grown in the forests of China. Bamboo is a grassy wood known to combine strength and flexibility. In their natural habitat, Bamboo shoots withstand high magnitude earthquakes and extreme winds by bending without ever snapping, this incredible feature in the plant's fiber is passed to each of Culina Bamboo Wood Cooking Utensils. Geared to utilitarian use at professional level or at home, the set will outlast the traditional (lumber-made) wooden counterparts. Durability, convenience and efficiency in the kitchen Besides an heirloom feel the set of Culina bamboo utensils provides to your decor, the real beauty remains efficiency and endurance. Culina utensil set is: suited to everything from mixing, stirring, slow-cooking, dipping, scooping, to sautéing, grilling, folding egg whites and more! heatproof and safe even when left to lean against pots. Steam-resistant: utensils do not bend, bubble or snap easily Scratch free: will not damage nonstick cookware. Nice and sturdy to remove fond Heavy duty designed: crafted for utilitarian use by professionals or at home Perfect to get the job done with great satisfaction as it proves consistent over the years.
